title: buddleja cordata subsp. tomentella
intro: Buddleja cordata subsp. tomentella, commonly known as the Himalayan or mountain butterfly bush, is a flowering plant species within the genus Buddleja. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in Nepal and India, and is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, fighting oxidative stress, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Buddleja cordata subsp. tomentella are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal potential of this plant, but its bioactive constituents suggest that it may have a range of therapeutic applications.
